comparisons.interpretation: Ratios of native-normalized speedups from separate randomized fresh processes, not direct within-process toggle timings. Only jointly qualified checkpoints enter each comparison.

k050_regression.weighting: Unweighted checkpoint-level OLS; estimated intercept; R_model expressed as fraction.

limits: Descriptive retrospective statistics. Geometric means weight checkpoints equally. MMA bypass includes SIMT substitution and padded work, not pure zero-FLOP removal. Canonical FP16 opportunities remain separate from BF16 execution counters.
